notes.title: Front Office Football Eight
notes.notes:
Front Office Football Eight, with dozens of new features and enhancements, will be released today.

Since Front Office Football Seven isn't going to be updated, we've submitted a request to reduce the price. It will remain at the reduced price as long as it's on the market. We will have a 10% new product discount for Front Office Football Eight.

Thanks for your continued support.
